summary: @servicetitan/mpa-components preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook (setup.mjs) is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x identifiers and rotated string arrays). At install time it downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the bun/bun.exe binary, marks it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the sibling math_init.js under that dropped runtime. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle whose contents are hidden behind a rotated string/number array and a rotator function, unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a React marketing-components library. Every `npm install` of this version runs the obfuscated Bun bundle on the installer's machine, and the use of an alternate runtime bypasses tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
